name: Etsy Video Generation - FFmpeg Slideshow (Ultra Low Cost)

parameters.system: You are an expert at creating engaging product video text overlays. Generate concise, compelling text for video slides.

content.text:
Analyze this product and create text overlays for a 6-second video slideshow. Return ONLY a JSON object:

{
  "slide1_text": "[Main product name/benefit - 3-5 words]",
  "slide2_text": "[Key feature - 3-5 words]",
  "slide3_text": "[Call to action - 3-5 words]",
  "product_name": "[Short product name]"
}

Examples:
- slide1_text: "Handmade Silver Jewelry"
- slide2_text: "Premium Quality Materials"
- slide3_text: "Shop Now on Etsy"

Return ONLY the JSON object.

metadata.notes: AI generates text overlays for video slides (uses cheaper Haiku model)
Parse AI response and set variables

mapper.text:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Create temp directory
mkdir -p {{4.temp_dir}}

# Save original image
echo '{{base64(2.data)}}' | base64 -d > {{4.temp_dir}}/original.jpg

# Create 3 variations with ImageMagick (zoom, text overlays)
# Slide 1: Zoom in effect
convert {{4.temp_dir}}/original.jpg -resize 1280x720^ -gravity center -extent 1280x720 {{4.temp_dir}}/frame1.jpg

# Slide 2: With text overlay
convert {{4.temp_dir}}/original.jpg -resize 1280x720^ -gravity center -extent 1280x720 \
  -fill white -stroke black -strokewidth 2 -pointsize 60 -gravity center \
  -annotate +0+0 '{{4.video_text.slide1_text}}' {{4.temp_dir}}/frame2.jpg

# Slide 3: With feature text
convert {{4.temp_dir}}/original.jpg -resize 1280x720^ -gravity center -extent 1280x720 \
  -fill white -stroke black -strokewidth 2 -pointsize 50 -gravity center \
  -annotate +0+0 '{{4.video_text.slide2_text}}' {{4.temp_dir}}/frame3.jpg

# Slide 4: Call to action
convert {{4.temp_dir}}/original.jpg -resize 1280x720^ -gravity center -extent 1280x720 \
  -fill '#FFD700' -stroke black -strokewidth 3 -pointsize 55 -gravity center \
  -annotate +0+0 '{{4.video_text.slide3_text}}' {{4.temp_dir}}/frame4.jpg

# Create video with FFmpeg (crossfade transitions)
ffmpeg -y \
  -loop 1 -t 1.5 -i {{4.temp_dir}}/frame1.jpg \
  -loop 1 -t 1.5 -i {{4.temp_dir}}/frame2.jpg \
  -loop 1 -t 1.5 -i {{4.temp_dir}}/frame3.jpg \
  -loop 1 -t 1.5 -i {{4.temp_dir}}/frame4.jpg \
  -filter_complex "
    [0:v]fade=t=in:st=0:d=0.3,fade=t=out:st=1.2:d=0.3,zoompan=z='min(zoom+0.0015,1.1)':d=1:fps=30[v0];
    [1:v]fade=t=in:st=0:d=0.3,fade=t=out:st=1.2:d=0.3[v1];
    [2:v]fade=t=in:st=0:d=0.3,fade=t=out:st=1.2:d=0.3[v2];
    [3:v]fade=t=in:st=0:d=0.3,fade=t=out:st=1.2:d=0.3[v3];
    [v0][v1][v2][v3]concat=n=4:v=1:a=0[outv]
  " \
  -map "[outv]" \
  -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 23 \
  -movflags +faststart \
  {{4.temp_dir}}/output.mp4

# Output base64 encoded video
base64 -w 0 {{4.temp_dir}}/output.mp4

# Cleanup
rm -rf {{4.temp_dir}}
